notes.title: Demo version 1.5 is now live!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone and thank you for playing our game so far!

We got some feedbacks about bugs here and there.

The new version 1.5 fixes those issues and the game should work perfectly now!

Let us know if anything else goes wrong and we will do our best to fix it as soon as possible ;)

-- Kibou Entertainment team --
